cleavage_agent.evidence: Extracted proteins were digested with trypsin and peptides analyzed in two technical replicates on an LTQ-Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

enrichment_method.evidence: For phosphoproteomics experiments, TiO2 enrichment method was used in two independent biological replicates and run in two technical replicates in an LTQ Orbitrap or in a Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

instrument.evidence: The proteomics analysis of sensitive and resistant MCF7 cells in basal conditions and phosphoproteomics analysis of the G2 cells in the presence of inhibitors of the PI3K pathway were run in a nano flow ultrahigh pressure liquid chromatography (UPLC, nano Acquity, Waters) coupled to an LTQ-Orbitrap XL mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

The phosphoproteomics study of sensitive and resistant MCF7 cells in basal conditions was run in a Dionex UltiMate 3000  RSLCnano coupled to an Orbitrap Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
